falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low would invalidate the 76% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug, as that bottom held at ~4,800; this would signal the pattern has failed and we're in a deeper drawdown than the reference case

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking near 28; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic-driven liquidation rather than the orderly bottoming process the pattern suggests, invalidating the 'bottom' analog and forcing a reassessment of market structure

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 is simultaneously below 5,200
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination signals a flight-to-safety recession panic rather than a growth-scare bottom; in August 2024, yields fell with equities but the pattern held because stocks stabilized quickly—if yields collapse with stocks still falling, it confirms economic deterioration that the bottom pattern cannot accommodate

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
